Tag can only be fired per event but can be fired multiple times per load (e.g., app load or page load).
Tag can only be fired per load (e.g., app load or page load).

notes.description: User notes on how to apply this tag in the container.

monitoringMetadata.description: A map of key-value pairs of tag metadata to be included in the event data for tag monitoring. Notes: - This parameter must be type MAP. - Each parameter in the map are type TEMPLATE, however cannot contain variable references.

blockingTriggerId.description: Blocking trigger IDs. If any of the listed triggers evaluate to true, the tag will not fire.

tagManagerUrl.description: Auto generated link to the tag manager UI

liveOnly.description: If set to true, this tag will only fire in the live environment (e.g. not in preview or debug mode).

setupTag.description: The list of setup tags. Currently we only allow one.

scheduleStartMs.description: The start timestamp in milliseconds to schedule a tag.

firingTriggerId.description: Firing trigger IDs. A tag will fire when any of the listed triggers are true and all of its blockingTriggerIds (if any specified) are false.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the GTM Tag as computed at storage time. This value is recomputed whenever the tag is modified.

paused.description: Indicates whether the tag is paused, which prevents the tag from firing.

scheduleEndMs.description: The end timestamp in milliseconds to schedule a tag.

tagId.description: The Tag ID uniquely identifies the GTM Tag.

monitoringMetadataTagNameKey.description: If non-empty, then the tag display name will be included in the monitoring metadata map using the key specified.

priority.description: User defined numeric priority of the tag. Tags are fired asynchronously in order of priority. Tags with higher numeric value fire first. A tag's priority can be a positive or negative value. The default value is 0.

teardownTag.description: The list of teardown tags. Currently we only allow one.

nextPageToken.description: Continuation token for fetching the next page of results.

gtagConfig.description: All Google tag configs in a Container.

convertNullToValue.description: The value to convert if a variable value is null.

convertTrueToValue.description: The value to convert if a variable value is true.

convertToBoolean.description: The option to convert a variable value to a boolean.

convertUndefinedToValue.description: The value to convert if a variable value is undefined.

caseConversionType.description: The option to convert a string-type variable value to either lowercase or uppercase.
enumDescriptions: The option to convert a variable value to lowercase.
The option to convert a variable value to uppercase.

convertFalseToValue.description: The value to convert if a variable value is false.

convertToNumber.description: The option to convert a variable value to a number.
enumDescriptions: The option to convert a variable value to a number with a period as the decimal separator.
The option to convert a variable value to a number with a comma as the decimal separator.
The option to convert a variable value to a number with automatic decimal separator detection.

tagManagerUrl.description: Auto generated link to the tag manager UI

accountId.description: The Account ID uniquely identifies the GTM Account.

shareData.description: Whether the account shares data anonymously with Google and others. This flag enables benchmarking by sharing your data in an anonymous form. Google will remove all identifiable information about your website, combine the data with hundreds of other anonymous sites and report aggregate trends in the benchmarking service.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the GTM Account as computed at storage time. This value is recomputed whenever the account is modified.

Account.description: Represents a Google Tag Manager Account.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the Google Tag Destination as computed at storage time. This value is recomputed whenever the destination is modified.

tagManagerUrl.description: Auto generated link to the tag manager UI.

destinationLinkId.description: The Destination link ID uniquely identifies the Destination.

FolderEntities.description: Represents a Google Tag Manager Folder's contents.

tag.description: The list of tags inside the folder.

nextPageToken.description: Continuation token for fetching the next page of results.

variable.description: The list of variables inside the folder.

trigger.description: The list of triggers inside the folder.

RevertTriggerResponse.description: The result of reverting a trigger in a workspace.

trigger.description: Trigger as it appears in the latest container version since the last workspace synchronization operation. If no trigger is present, that means the trigger was deleted in the latest container version.

owner.description: The name of the owner for the community gallery template.

signature.description: The signature of the community gallery template as computed at import time. This value is recomputed whenever the template is updated from the gallery.

repository.description: The name of the repository for the community gallery template.

isModified.description: If a user has manually edited the community gallery template.

galleryTemplateId.description: ID for the gallery template that is generated once during first sync and travels with the template redirects.

host.description: The name of the host for the community gallery template.

templateDeveloperId.description: The developer id of the community gallery template. This value is set whenever the template is created from the gallery.

version.description: The version of the community gallery template.

GalleryReference.description: Represents the link between a custom template and an entry on the Community Template Gallery site.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the Google tag config as computed at storage time. This value is recomputed whenever the config is modified.

gtagConfigId.description: The ID uniquely identifies the Google tag config.

path.description: Google tag config's API relative path.

workspaceId.description: Google tag workspace ID. Only used by GTM containers. Set to 0 otherwise.

transformation.description: All GTM Transformations of a GTM Container.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the GTM Client as computed at storage time. This value is recomputed whenever the client is modified.

tagManagerUrl.description: Auto generated link to the tag manager UI

clientId.description: The Client ID uniquely identifies the GTM client.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the GTM Folder as computed at storage time. This value is recomputed whenever the folder is modified.

notes.description: User notes on how to apply this folder in the container.

folderId.description: The Folder ID uniquely identifies the GTM Folder.

Folder.description: Represents a Google Tag Manager Folder.

ContainerAccess.description: Defines the Google Tag Manager Container access permissions.

Entity.description: A workspace entity that may represent a tag, trigger, variable, or folder in addition to its status in the workspace.

gtagConfig.description: The gtag config being represented by the entity.

customTemplate.description: The custom template being represented by the entity.

tag.description: The tag being represented by the entity.

folder.description: The folder being represented by the entity.

trigger.description: The trigger being represented by the entity.

builtInVariable.description: The built in variable being represented by the entity.

transformation.description: The transformation being represented by the entity.

variable.description: The variable being represented by the entity.

zone.description: The zone being represented by the entity.

client.description: The client being represented by the entity.

changeStatus.description: Represents how the entity has been changed in the workspace.
enumDescriptions: The entity has never been changed.
The entity is added to the workspace.
The entity is deleted from the workspace.
The entity has been updated in the workspace.

variable.description: Variable as it appears in the latest container version since the last workspace synchronization operation. If no variable is present, that means the variable was deleted in the latest container version.
